title: Initial Recruiter Outreach
description: Template for initial message to a recruiter on LinkedIn or email.
template:
Hi [Recruiter Name],

I came across the [Job Title] opportunity at [Company Name] and was excited to learn about the role. With my background in [relevant skill/technology] and [years] years of experience in the tech industry, I believe I could make a meaningful contribution to your team.

My key skills include [Skill 1], [Skill 2], and [Skill 3]. In my current role, I [brief achievement or responsibility relevant to the role].

I'd welcome the chance to connect and discuss how my experience aligns with your needs. Would you be open to a brief chat this week?

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your LinkedIn Profile]
[Your Phone Number]
[Your Email]
